<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex705-1104-2023-06-28" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (93a4)"/>
             <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4492"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos</rs> kyi tshig dang don gyi cha rgya cher bsnyad pa phra ba'i don gsal ba</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="person" ref="db:3805" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shag kya'i dge slong chos kyi bla ma</rs>'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos nod pa <rs type="person" ref="db:3831" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dge slong chos kyi seng ge</rs>s nye bar sbyar pa rdzogs s+hO |||| ||<note type="translation">The “Clarifier of subtle meaning,” an extensive commentary on the words and meanings of the Mahāyānottaratantraśāstra compiled by the monk Chos kyi seng ge, who touched with his head the dust of feet of the Śākya monk Chos kyi bla ma, is completed.</note></seg></TEI>
